title: The First 10 Minutes Of Urinetown Are Musical Comedy Heaven

contact_edits.before: All toilet facilities have been handed over to a private corporation that runs them on a fee-for-use basis. A musical satire on matters political and environmental that's also a satire on the idea of doing a musical satire in the first place: It's not always as funny as it thinks it is but certainly as clever. The score is super-pastiche that retains its own delighted voice; the staging adds its own zany commentary; and the first 10 minutes are musical- comedy heaven. (Bluma Appel Theatre, 27 Front St. E., 416-368-3110. Until Labour Day weekend.)
